<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/reason_codes"}
#docs
`?offered=true` (requires `applies_to`) returns enabled codes in order, substituting built-in defaults when the business has defined none — the shape a cancel/refund picker should render.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `applies_to` | `string` | no | Only reason codes for this use. |
| `offered` | `string` | no | Set to `true` to list only the codes that are enabled. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Unknown applies_to, or applies_to missing with offered=true |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/reason_codes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

{}

    "message": "Unknown applies_to, or applies_to missing with offered=true"
  }
}
